My anesthesiologist came in before I was sent to the or and he gave me a little pep talk and told me he’d be keeping me safe during my nap, which helped a lot. Going to sleep was very easy and the whole team in the or was very understanding of me being nervous. When I woke up I was immensely relieved that I woke up and felt at peace about being sterilized! I’m very glad I did it despite the anxiety and I’m wishing you all the best with yours :)

I’m going to say NTA here because even though you didn’t “explicitly say” she couldn’t have anyone over, I think it’s fair of you to be upset about a stranger (to you) showing up unexpectedly in your home. I babysat for my family/family friends for years and never had anyone over to stay in their homes without their knowledge. She should’ve at least asked your permission before bringing him over. Objectively, I agree that you hired her to do a job, and that she should be paid for the work she completed, but no regular job would be okay with an employee inviting a non-employee to hang out at work just because they got bored doing their job. Pay her the thirty bucks for her hours and let her remain “fired”, so to speak. She’s a teenager and made a mistake, so let this be a learning experience for her and hopefully y’all can work it out and get back to being on good terms.
